notes: The preview is not a random sample and must not be used to report model accuracy.
English and school mathematics responses do not establish student knowledge in Python, AI, cloud, or cybersecurity.
No learner-level dataset is published on the public GitHub Pages site.
Model code in the repository does not imply that full-scale training has been executed.
